copy.curiosityHook: Once a timid teenager trades places with the malevolent presence inside the glass, what does her dark reflection plan to do with her life?
copy.description: In Assaf Bernstein's psychological horror thriller, an alienated, timid high school student finds her fragile world upended after swapping places with her sinister reflection in the mirror.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful fantasy thriller dealing in eerie alienation and psychological tension, best suited for an engaged solo viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Anchored by an uncanny premise, this eerie thriller turns adolescent isolation into a chilling fantasy of supernatural identity exchange and mounting dread.

allowedMaterial: Timid and socially alienated 17-year-old high school student
Identity swap with a sinister mirror image
Fantasy horror and thriller genre atmosphere
excludedMaterial: Specific revenge acts or victim identities
End of the mirror swap outcome
